concerns.text: The idea's Methodology sketch explicitly requires 'Baseline Comparison: Train an identical student model using the original Causal Forcing++ protocol (neural diffusion teacher) on the same dataset.' The spec consumes the neural-teacher baseline in US-03/FR-004/FR-005 but has NO user story or FR covering training/obtaining that baseline. Without it, the paired t-test and the entire trade-off quantification (Constitution VII) have no second arm. Add an FR (and ideally a story or explicit scope note) for producing the neural-teacher baseline on the same dataset.

The idea's Ablation Study ('vary the complexity of the physics simulation, e.g., adding friction, elasticity, or fluid dynamics') appears only as US-03 scenario 3 and has no corresponding Functional Requirement. Promote it to an FR so the ablation is not silently droppable at planning time.
